title: Cardinal Billing Account Notice of Cancellation Timing and State Notice Periods
content:
A notice of cancellation for nonpayment on a Cardinal Billing Account is timed by the pay plan and by the state whose law governs the policy.

## Plan figures

| Pay plan | Days past due that trigger a notice (calendar days) | Smallest past-due amount noticed | Mailing allowance (calendar days) | Effective time | Rescission cutoff (calendar days after the cancellation effective date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Direct Bill Monthly Plan | 10 | $10.00 | 5 | 12:01 a.m. local time | 0 |
| Cardinal Card Autopay Monthly Plan | 10 | $10.00 | 5 | 12:01 a.m. local time | 0 |
| Cardinal EFT Autopay Monthly Plan | 10 | $10.00 | 5 | 12:01 a.m. local time | 0 |
| Cardinal Three-Pay Plan | 12 | $10.00 | 5 | 12:01 a.m. local time | 0 |
| Cardinal Two-Pay Plan | 15 | $10.00 | 5 | 12:01 a.m. local time | 0 |
| Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan | 15 | $10.00 | 5 | 12:01 a.m. local time | 0 |

## State notice periods (minimum calendar days between the notice mail date and the cancellation effective date, every pay plan)

| Governing state | Notice days |
|---|---|
| Ohio (OH) | 10 |
| Indiana (IN) | 10 |
| Kentucky (KY) | 14 |
| Virginia (VA) | 15 |
| West Virginia (WV) | 15 |

## Notes

- The mailing allowance of 5 calendar days is added to the state notice period.
- A rescission cutoff of 0 means the amount required to rescind must be received on or before the cancellation effective date.
- A cancellation, and a reinstatement, takes effect at 12:01 a.m. local time on its date.

Hypothetical reading: for a Kentucky policy the notice period is 14 days and the mailing allowance 5 days, 19 calendar days in all between the mail date and the cancellation effective date; for an Ohio policy it is 10 and 5, 15 calendar days in all.
